svg.aria-label: pyrox-ssm on the GeoStack role ladder: conditioning, the evidence factors, the Kalman recursions and the path samplers as algorithms; the priors and their conditioned results as models; the non-Gaussian strategies and the implicit adjoint as strategies; prediction, the linear-Gaussian form, the site padding and a non-centred site helper as primitives; no structure of its own. Beside the ladder, the gaussx SDE kernels pyrox-ssm re-exports.
